Working directory: . (not a git repo, that's fine, just work with plain files).

Task: Implement a function `maxMeetings` in `src/schedule.js` (create the file if it doesn't exist; if it exists, read it first and add/implement the function there).

Spec: `maxMeetings(meetings)` takes an array of meetings, each represented as `[start, end)` half-open intervals (e.g. `[1, 3]` means starts at 1, ends at 3, exclusive of 3). It should return the maximum number of meetings that can be attended without any overlap, where one meeting is allowed to start exactly when the previous one ends (i.e. back-to-back meetings are fine, since intervals are half-open). This is the classic "activity selection" problem — solve it greedily by sorting meetings by end time and picking each meeting whose start is >= the end time of the last picked meeting.

Export the function appropriately (use CommonJS `module.exports` unless the rest of the project — check if there's a package.json with "type": "module" or existing src files — indicates ESM; since there likely are no existing files, default to CommonJS `module.exports = { maxMeetings };`).

Use your file-editing tool (Write/Edit) to actually create/edit `src/schedule.js` — don't just describe the code.

Also create `src/NOTES.md` containing exactly one sentence (your choice of wording) describing what `src/schedule.js` does.

After writing both files, report back the final contents of both files.
